stadium.name: Bukit Jalil National Stadium (TM Stadium Nasional)
stadium.note: Largest stadium in Southeast Asia; built for the 1998 Commonwealth Games; membrane roof. Renamed TM Stadium Nasional in March 2026. The National Sports Complex covers 1.2 km² (same article).

arena.name: Unifi Arena (ex-Axiata Arena, Stadium Putra)
arena.note: Highest-capacity indoor venue in Malaysia. Renamed Unifi Arena from 6 March 2026.

pavilion.transit: SP19 Awan Besar LRT via free shuttle bus, 40-minute intervals
pavilion.parkBridge: a linked bridge connecting the recreational park and the mall on Level 5

line4.name: Sri Petaling Line
line4.publisher: Wikipedia – Ampang and Sri Petaling lines (KVITS line 4, maroon); hex from Wikipedia Module:Adjacent stations/Rapid KL
line4.note: SP17 opened with the 11 July 1998 section; SP19/SP20 with the 31 October 2015 extension. SP17 and SP19 also listed as 'Public transit' for the stadium/arena and Pavilion respectively.
